source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A dignified royal hall: regal and ceremonial, stone pillars and banners, measured and proud. Tempo 84 BPM, 4/4 time, key of B♭ major. Instrumentation: trumpet and horn fanfare motifs, harpsichord, timpani, snare ruffs, full strings. Form: short fanfare, stately main theme, softer middle with harpsichord, return. Duration: 80 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
